import json,random
random.seed(12)
cases=[]
for ci in range(8):
 S=256;J=128;F=16;G=8
 slots=[[s,5,0 if s==0 else random.randint(0,5)] for s in range(S)]
 # tree groups arbitrary parent lower index
 groups=[]
 for g in range(G):groups.append([-1 if g==0 else random.randrange(g),random.randint(20,512)])
 flows=[]
 for f in range(F):
  target=random.randint(1,20);ceil=random.randint(target,min(64,512));grp=random.randrange(G);flows.append([target,ceil,grp,random.randrange(7)])
 wins=[]
 for j in range(J):
  f=random.randrange(F);ready=random.randint(0,S*3//4);exp=random.randint(max(ready,1),S-1)
  wins.append([f,ready,exp,random.randint(1,65535),random.randint(1,320),random.randint(0,65535),random.randint(1,1000),[[0,0]]*9])
 cases.append({'model':'cnn' if ci%2==0 else 'rnn','class_values':[random.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(7)],'stats':[random.randint(1,100),random.randint(1,100),random.randint(1,100)],'bucket':[random.randint(1,512),0],'slots':slots,'flows':flows,'groups':groups,'windows':wins})
json.dump({'version':3,'cases':cases},open('/workspace/tmp/batch_request.json','w'),separators=(',',':'))
PY
